result.instructions: Tools for Qoblex, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are running low on stock, and which sale orders are waiting for them?"; "List the open sale orders created this week with their status and totals."; "Show the open purchase orders for supplier 42 and when they were created.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Qoblex data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run qoblex_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run qoblex_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run qoblex_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. qoblex_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: qoblex_get_current_user
tools.title: Get the current user
tools.description: Return the user that owns the API key: id, name, email, timezone and permissions. Good first call to confirm the connection. Qoblex API: GET /v1/users/me.

tools.name: qoblex_get_account
tools.title: Get account details
tools.description: Return the Qoblex account (company) details and settings for this key. Qoblex API: GET /v1/account.

tools.name: qoblex_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products in the catalogue, with optional filters, sorting and related records (variants, images, mappings). Qoblex API: GET /v1/products.

filters.description: Filter expression, e.g. `name@=shirt,quantity>10`. Operators are listed in the Qoblex API overview.

sort_by.description: Sort fields, comma-separated; prefix a field with `-` for descending.

expand.description: Comma-separated related resources to include in the response (see the Qoblex API reference for each endpoint).

tools.name: qoblex_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Return one product by id, optionally with related records expanded. Qoblex API: GET /v1/products/{id}.

id.description: The numeric id of the record, from the matching list tool.

expand.description: Comma-separated related resources to include in the response (see the Qoblex API reference for each endpoint).

tools.name: qoblex_get_variant_inventory

include_count.description: Include the total count of matching orders.
